scenario_info.title: NVIDIA -> Oracle (supplier relationship)
scenario_info.description: The stored excerpt of the NVIDIA/Oracle release of 27 Oct 2026 (recorded from nvidianews.nvidia.com; nothing is fetched). Two claims are made about it: that the two companies merely appear together, and that NVIDIA supplies Oracle.

claims.label: Claim A: the two companies appear in the same sentence
claims.meaning: Declares the relationship as stated by the text, with no wording that states it. Co-occurrence is not a relationship.

claims.label: Claim B: NVIDIA supplies Oracle, asserted by the proposer
claims.meaning: Declares the relationship with a written rationale because the sentence does not say 'supplies'. A reviewer must confirm it explicitly.

domains.label: Relationship evidence
domains.supported: Contract, source storage, quote re-verification, direction and co-occurrence rules, review with explicit acknowledgement, release, rollback and a read-only overlay in the Graph Explorer and the Event Impact Map.
domains.limits: Approved relationships carry no criticality and never change a score; adopting one into canonical data is a deliberate, separate step.

domains.label: Event evidence
domains.supported: Contract, ingestion, verification against stored sources, review, release and rollback. Event discovery runs stage events into the same review queue.
domains.limits: Approved event releases are consumed by the Impact Map's dynamic-discovery mode, not by this page's overlay view; no impact is estimated.

domains.label: Reference entities
domains.supported: Contract and checks (link kinds are kept apart from holdings); approved rows feed the linked-counterparty report.
domains.limits: No graph overlay; a trade reference is never presented as a holding.

domains.label: Portfolio holdings
domains.supported: Contract, validation, issuer resolution, review, release, rollback and export.
domains.limits: Approved holdings are not read by analytics until a person adopts the export; the portfolio and CCR counterparty populations are never merged.

domains.label: CCR exposures and limits
domains.supported: Contract with typed measures, units, currencies, netting sets, limits, utilization and as-of dates; consistency and orphan checks; review and release.
domains.limits: No measured exposure values are bundled, nothing is converted or defaulted, and no wrong-way risk is assessed from positions.

domains.label: CCR counterparty master
domains.limits: Not read by analytics until a person adopts the export.

domains.label: Canonical fact edges
domains.limits: Not read by scoring until a person adopts the export.

domains.label: Entity master
domains.limits: Not read by analytics until a person adopts the export.

domains.label: Price history
domains.limits: Not read by analytics until a person adopts the export.

domains.label: Any other table
domains.supported: Profiled (types, completeness, duplicates) and never promoted.
